INSERT INTO shift_patients (shift_id, patient_id, position)
               SELECT s.id, $2,
                      COALESCE((SELECT MAX(sp.position) + 1
                                  FROM shift_patients sp WHERE sp.shift_id = s.id), 0)
                 FROM shifts s
                WHERE s.clinician_id = $1 AND s.status = 'active'
               ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
